title: Tax added twice

agents.task: Make calculateTotal in src/checkout.ts return the final price the customer pays, including state sales tax (use applyTax from src/tax.ts). Add a state parameter that defaults to "CA" so existing callers get the taxed price. Update the existing tests so they match the new behavior and add a test for a non-default state.

Add a state parameter to orderSummary in src/order.ts and show tax as its own line in the receipt: compute total = calculateTotal(items, promo), tax = applyTax(total, state) - total, add a line "Tax $x.xx" before the Total line, and make the returned total and the Total line include tax. Add tests.

notes: Each task alone keeps its suite green. Together orderSummary taxes a total that calculateTotal already taxed. Correct merge: orderSummary gets the pre-tax amount from applyDiscount(subtotal) and the taxed total from calculateTotal(items, promo, state).
